summary: Growth Diligence Phase 1 tested end-to-end: 9/9 backend pytest cases pass (demo seed listing, CRUD, upload+suggested mapping incl. correct pnl cost_of_revenue disambiguation, save mapping, compute w/ NRR≈112.7 & sales cycle≈60 & missing_data=[], provenance sources present, results 409 for draft, delete cascade). Full UI flow verified: Audit Hub, Create Audit modal, Mapping Wizard uploads for revenue/crm/pnl, confirm mappings, Compute → Dashboard w/ 6 metric cards, provenance popover, charts (MRR area, NRR line, cohort heatmap w/168 cells), Path to Plan, Diagnostics page (Missing Data + Anomaly Flags), and delete flow with confirmation. All requested data-testids present. One CRITICAL backend bug found: GET /api/audits/{demo_id} returns HTTP 500 for the two seeded demo audits due to non-JSON-compliant float (NaN/Inf) in stored payload — this breaks the top-nav tabs on any demo-audit page (audit fetch fails, Layout renders no tabs, so nav-tab-missing-data/-mapping-wizard/-growth-dashboard are invisible from a demo dashboard, though the /results-backed dashboard itself still renders).

critical.issue: HTTP 500 'Out of range float values are not JSON compliant' for both seeded demo audits. Likely source: `audit_public()` returns the raw Mongo audit doc which includes `results` (from ge.compute_all) containing NaN/Inf floats — Starlette's default json.dumps rejects them. Fresh (non-demo) audits work because their `results` field is null before compute. Fix idea: sanitize the returned payload (replace NaN/Inf with None) OR use a JSON encoder allow_nan=False+ custom replace OR exclude `results` in `audit_public` projection (Dashboard uses /results endpoint separately). Note the same encoder is fine for /results — the results endpoint appears not to hit the same edge case suggesting the offending NaN is inside a numeric field the results endpoint would also serialize; recommend a global custom JSONResponse or a recursive sanitize helper.

ui_bugs.issue: On demo audit pages, top-nav tabs (nav-tab-growth-dashboard / -mapping-wizard / -missing-data) are absent because `getAudit(id)` returns 500 → `audit` stays null → tabs suppressed. Root cause is the backend 500 above; UI does not surface an error toast either.

integration_issues.issue: Dashboard body renders (uses /results), but any interaction that depends on the audit object failing to load (tabs, delete/data buttons on nested pages) is silently broken. No user-visible error is shown.

issues: React warning: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby' on Radix DialogContent (accessibility)

action_items: Fix GET /api/audits/{id} 500 on demo audits: sanitize NaN/Inf before response (e.g., recursive replace with None in audit_public, or exclude `results` since Dashboard already uses /results). Verify by curl on both seeded demo audit ids.
Consider showing a UI error toast when getAudit fails so users are not left with a spinner or hidden tabs.
Add aria-describedby (or DialogDescription) to the New Audit DialogContent for a11y.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py `audit_public()` returns the whole audit document including `results` which contains numeric metrics — any NaN/Inf produced by growth_engine breaks JSON serialization. Preferred fix: strip `results` in the projection (Dashboard uses /results anyway) or wrap the app with a NaN-safe JSONResponse.

df_to_records handles NaN/Inf per row, but this cleaning is bypassed for anything computed after seed (i.e., `results` dict returned by compute_all and stored via update_one). Add the same sanitization to compute output before persisting.
Layout hides all tabs when `audit` is null — consider still rendering tabs using the URL param `id` so navigation remains usable during transient fetch errors.

rca of the issue: GET /api/audits/{demo_id} → 500 ValueError: Out of range float values are not JSON compliant. Traceback ends in starlette/responses.py json.dumps (default allow_nan=False). Reproduction: `curl $BASE/api/audits/$(curl -s $BASE/api/audits | jq -r '.[0].id')` → 500. Cause: audit_public() returns the whole audit doc including compute results, which contain NaN/Inf (e.g., ratios where denominator is 0, or cac_payback of an infinity). Mitigation options: (a) exclude `results` in audit_public projection (safe; Dashboard fetches results via /api/audits/{id}/results); (b) recursively replace NaN/Inf with None before returning; (c) subclass JSONResponse to use json.dumps(..., allow_nan=True) or a custom encoder that emits null for non-finite floats.
